AboutPage.metaDescription: Learn more about VelnoxLabs. 51+ free, fast, and private browser-based tools for developers and everyday work. No sign-up. 100% privacy.
AboutPage.title: About VelnoxLabs
AboutPage.heroText: VelnoxLabs is a collection of 51+ free, browser-based tools designed for developers and everyday work. No sign-up. No tracking. No hidden charges. Just fast, private utilities that run 100% in your browser.

features.privateDesc: All tools execute purely client-side. Your data never leaves your device, and we never upload or store your payloads on any server.
features.frictionDesc: No account creation, sign-up forms, or paywalls. Open the tool you need and complete your task instantly.
features.devDesc: From JSON formatting to cURL conversion and Cron generation, our tools streamline your daily workflow.
features.freeDesc: We believe essential utilities should be accessible to everyone. All 51+ tools are 100% free to use.

AboutPage.storyText: I was tired of slow, ad-filled tool websites that upload your data to their servers just to format a simple JSON file or resize an image. So I built VelnoxLabs — a place where you can use everyday developer and utility tools without any friction. Everything runs in your browser, so your privacy is always protected.

json-formatter.whatIsHeading: What is a JSON Formatter & Validator?
json-formatter.whatIsText: The JSON Formatter & Validator beautifies raw or minified JSON and detects syntax errors with precise feedback. Developers use it daily for debugging API responses and cleaning up configuration files.

json-formatter.howTo2: The tool processes your input instantly in real-time.

json-formatter.howTo4: Use Minify to compress JSON into a single line.
json-formatter.howTo5: Click the Copy button to copy the result.
json-formatter.faq1Q: Is this tool free to use?
json-formatter.faq1A: Yes, VelnoxLabs JSON Formatter & Validator is 100% free with no sign-up required.
json-formatter.faq2A: Absolutely. All processing happens entirely in your browser using client-side JavaScript. Your data never leaves your device and is never sent to any server.
json-formatter.faq3Q: Does it work on mobile devices?
json-formatter.faq3A: Yes, this tool is fully responsive and works on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.

age-calculator.name: Age Calculator
age-calculator.description: Calculate exact age in years, months, days, hours.
age-calculator.pageSubtitle: Calculate your exact age in years, months, days, hours, and minutes — plus your next birthday countdown and zodiac sign.
age-calculator.seoDescription: An Age Calculator is a free online tool that calculates your exact age from your date of birth. Unlike a simple year difference, it provides a precise breakdown in years, months, days, hours, minutes, and total weeks. It also shows the day of the week you were born, your zodiac sign, and the number of days until your next birthday. It is useful for forms, legal documents, visa applications, or satisfying your curiosity.
age-calculator.howToStep1: Select your date of birth using the date picker.
age-calculator.howToStep2: Your exact age appears instantly in years, months, and days.
age-calculator.howToStep3: View your total time lived in months, weeks, days, hours, and minutes.
age-calculator.howToStep4: See your zodiac sign, day of birth, and next birthday countdown.
age-calculator.howToStep5: Click Copy Full Report to save or share your results.
age-calculator.faq1Answer: Age is calculated by finding the difference between today's date and your date of birth. The tool accounts for leap years and varying month lengths to provide an exact breakdown in years, months, and days.
age-calculator.faq2Question: What is the difference between chronological and biological age?
age-calculator.faq2Answer: Chronological age is the actual time elapsed since you were born, which is what this calculator measures. Biological age reflects how old your body appears based on health markers and can differ from chronological age.
age-calculator.faq3Answer: No. All calculations happen entirely in your browser. Your birthdate is not sent to a server or stored by this calculator.
age-calculator.faq4Question: Can I use this for official documents?
age-calculator.faq4Answer: The results provide a mathematical age calculation and may help you complete visa applications, school forms, medical paperwork, and other documents requiring your age. Always follow the specific requirements of the relevant authority.
age-calculator.birthDateFutureError: Birth date cannot be in the future.
